nodes.description: Constant total token supply minted at construction (1,000,000,000 * 10**18).
Role identifier required to burn tokens.
ERC20 mapping of account balances, mutated by _transfer/_mint/_burn.
AccessControl mapping of role data (members and adminRole).
Initializable flag guarding the initializer modifier.
EIP712 domain separator hash used for typed message hashing.
Monotonic counter of snapshot ids used by the snapshot mechanism.
External burn function: requires BURNER_ROLE and amount > 0, then calls _burn.
External snapshot function guarded by DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE that calls _snapshot.
External ERC677 transfer that performs super.transfer then calls onTokenTransfer on a contract recipient.
Private view helper using extcodesize assembly to detect contract addresses.
Internal ERC20 burn that decrements balance and total supply.
Internal ERC20 mint used in the constructor to create INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Internal ERC20 transfer that mutates _balances.
AccessControl view returning whether an account holds a role.
Internal unrestricted role grant, used in the constructor for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
Initializer-guarded setup of the EIP712 domain separator.
Internal function that increments the snapshot counter and emits Snapshot.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and token transfers.
External call to IERC677Receiver.onTokenTransfer executed after the transfer completes.
Inline assembly extcodesize check inside isContract.
State mutation decrementing _balances and total supply inside _burn.
Burn amount supplied by the caller of burn().
Recipient address parameter of transferAndCall.
Token amount parameter of transferAndCall.
Arbitrary calldata payload forwarded to the ERC677 receiver.
Constructor recipient of the initial supply and default admin role.
Local variable holding the extcodesize result in isContract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is checked against BURNER_ROLE before burning, making caller identity an authorization input.
burn() calls hasRole to enforce the BURNER_ROLE permission check.
burn() delegates the actual balance and supply state mutation to _burn.
Caller-supplied amount parameter flows into burn() and its validation.
msg.sender is checked against DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE before snapshot creation.
snapshot() uses hasRole to enforce the admin restriction.
snapshot() forwards execution to the internal _snapshot routine.
_snapshot increments and reads the _currentSnapshotId counter state variable.
Recipient address parameter flows into the transferAndCall transfer and callback.
Value parameter flows into the token transfer and callback payload.
Data parameter flows into the external onTokenTransfer callback.
msg.sender is the source of the transfer and is passed to the receiver callback.
transferAndCall invokes super.transfer which executes the internal _transfer.
transferAndCall calls isContract to decide whether a callback must be made.
isContract performs the extcodesize assembly code-size check.
Local length variable receives the assembly extcodesize result.
transferAndCall invokes an arbitrary external contract callback after transferring tokens, enabling reentrancy.
The ERC677 receiver callback can re-enter the token transfer path while state is being observed.
The burn routine writes to the _balances state mapping.
Constructor recipient is granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE through _setupRole.
_setupRole performs its grant by calling the hasRole check inside _grantRole.
hasRole reads membership from the _roles state mapping.
_initializeEIP712 computes and stores the domainSeperator state variable.
The initializer modifier reads and sets the inited guard around _initializeEIP712.
Constructor recipient receives the minted INITIAL_SUPPLY via _mint.
_mint increases the recipient entry in the _balances mapping.
INITIAL_SUPPLY is passed as the amount to _mint during construction.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter has no independent security semantics; it only supplies the value consumed by burn() and its validation.
The _to parameter is only meaningful as the transfer target and callback destination inside transferAndCall.
The _value parameter is a scalar input consumed solely by the transfer and callback performed in transferAndCall.
The _data payload is forwarded directly to the external receiver and has no standalone role outside transferAndCall.
The constructor recipient is only used to seed the default admin role through _setupRole and to receive the initial mint.
The length local variable is a temporary holder for the extcodesize assembly result and collapses into isContract.
